description: Expander for MIX 4, MIX 4 STEREO, VCA MIX 4 and VCA MIX 4 STEREO, adding constant offset voltages around the level gains; it goes immediately to the right of the mix module

params.text: Adds a constant voltage between -10V and 10V to that numbered channel before its LEVEL knob is applied
Adds a constant voltage between -10V and 10V to the summed mix before the MIX level knob is applied
Adds a constant voltage between -10V and 10V to that numbered channel after its LEVEL knob is applied
Adds a constant voltage between -10V and 10V to the mix after the MIX level knob is applied

notes: these offsets appear in the numbered channel outputs of VCA MIX 4 and VCA MIX 4 STEREO, which the other mix expanders do not
one offset expander can be used per mix module, and it must be the first expander in the chain
the indicator lamp glows yellow once the expander has connected to a mix module
